data.title: What is Social Media Content?
data.subtitle: Social media demands constant fresh content. But quality shouldn't suffer for quantity. We create platform-specific social content that maintains your brand voice while driving engagement and growing your community.

steps.title: Brand Discovery
steps.text: We study your brand voice, audience, and competitors on each platform. Learn what resonates and what falls flat in your industry.

steps.title: Content Calendar
steps.text: Build a monthly calendar with themes, post types, and copy for each platform. You review and approve before anything goes live.

steps.title: Write and Schedule
steps.text: Our writers build each post for the platform it lives on. Each platform gets content built for how people use it.

steps.title: Report and Refine
steps.text: Monthly performance reports show what's working. We double down on winning formats and adjust what isn't performing.

paragraphs: Social falls over on cadence, not on ideas. The account starts strong, the founder gets busy, and three weeks of silence undo the month that came before it.

Giving the calendar to someone whose job it is fixes the gap. The posts keep landing in the weeks you are heads-down, which is exactly when your audience is deciding whether you are still worth following.

data.title: Why Choose Our Social Content?

items.question: Which social media platforms do you write for?
items.answer: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, and TikTok (scripts). We recommend focusing on 2-3 platforms where your audience is most active rather than spreading thin across all of them.

items.question: Do you post the content or just write it?
items.answer: We write and schedule the content. For clients using HubSpot, we publish directly through the Social tool. For other platforms, we deliver the content calendar and copy for your team to post. We do not publish from a founder or executive's personal LinkedIn profile, which stays in their hands.

items.question: How many posts per month do I get?
items.answer: Typical plans include 12-20 posts per month for your brand accounts across your chosen platforms. Volume depends on your goals and which platforms you are active on.

items.question: Can you repurpose our blog content for social?
items.answer: Yes. This is one of our most popular services. We take your existing blog posts, podcast episodes, or video content and extract social-ready content from them.

items.question: Can you write my CEO's LinkedIn?
items.answer: Yes, as a separate service. Writing under a person's own name starts with an interview with that person and gets its own voice profile, so it runs differently from brand-account work. Look for LinkedIn thought leadership under Content Creation.

data.text: Stop stressing about what to post. Our strategic social content keeps your channels active and your audience engaged.
